sloka: मान्या गुरु विनीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य गुरु प्रिया ।यदि सीता अपि दुह्ख आर्ता कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥५-१६-३॥
transliteration: mānyā guru vinītasya lakṣmaṇasya guru priyā ।yadi sītā api duhkha ārtā kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥5-16-3॥

translations.english: "If Sita, who is worshipped by righteous Lakshmana and loved by Rama is tortured like this, it shows it is difficult to trangress the force of time.
